text:
kai: hey @maria, we're hitting a 413 / RERANK_INPUT_TOO_LARGE when calling /v1/rerank. Response says \"tokens=10345 limit=8192\". We send query + ~120 docs (long product descriptions). Is this a hard per-request limit or something we can configure?

maria: thanks @kai — can you paste the exact response body + any X-Request-Id header? which model/version are you using?

kai: response body: `{\n  \"error\": \"RERANK_INPUT_TOO_LARGE\",\n  \"message\": \"tokens=10345 limit=8192\",\n  \"request_id\": \"req_abc123\"\n}`
headers: `x-request-id: req_abc123`, `content-length: 243`
model: `rerank-v1-base`
we're sending 120 docs, avg ~800 tokens each (we know it's long, but we need ranking at product-card level).

maria: ack. This is enforced as query_tokens + docs_tokens <= global limit for the rerank endpoint. The error currently reports combined tokens and limit which is confusing. Can you share a minimal curl that reproduces so eng can repro?

kai: here's a minimized repro (still fails):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\n    \"model\": \"rerank-v1-base\",\n    \"query\": \"Which product is best for outdoor use?\",\n    \"documents\": [\n      {\"id\": \"p1\", \"text\": \"<very long product description repeated...>\"},\n      {\"id\": \"p2\", \"text\": \"<very long product description repeated...>\"},\n      {\"id\": \"p3\", \"text\": \"<very long product description repeated...>\"}\n    ]\n  }'
```

josh: thanks, this is helpful. two quick things: (1) Supportable workaround is to chunk docs / batch reranks (e.g., rerank top-N in stages). (2) We should improve the error payload to show breakdown (query_tokens, docs_tokens). I'll create an ENG ticket.

kai: currently we tried embedding-filter -> rerank top50 and still hit the limit sometimes. Is there a param to limit per-doc length or auto-truncate?

maria: short-term: truncate each doc to the last ~512 tokens of the doc or to a heuristic window you care about (title + first 250 tokens). Another option: use our `max_context_tokens` beta param to enforce truncation server-side (I can enable for your org). Also consider multi-stage rerank: chunk docs into batches of 20-30, rerank each batch, then merge top results — pseudocode: `candidates = [] ; for batch in chunks(docs,30): candidates += rerank(query, batch); final = rerank(query, candidates[:50])`.

ana: sorry typo — actually Ana (Docs): I'll add guidance in the rerank docs about token budgeting, show tiktoken snippet, and document the chunk-and-merge pattern + a sample utility function. Will also add a callout about the current error message being ambiguous.

josh: filed ENG-4923 to add token breakdown in the 413 body and optionally return `query_tokens` and `docs_tokens`. target: next-week patch.

deploy-bot: created ticket ENG-4923 and linked to support thread 2087654321

kai: thanks everyone — enabling `max_context_tokens` beta would help us short-term. Also would appreciate the docs update so our frontend team knows how to chunk.

maria: I enabled the beta flag for your org and sent a private note with steps. I'll follow up once ENG-4923 has a PR. :thumbsup:

kai: great, marking this resolved for now until the error messaging change. Appreciate the fast turnaround. :pray:
